adentics.problem: A multi-location dental group operating across German-speaking cities had no unified digital experience for patients. Each clinic ran independently — separate appointment systems, no shared treatment history, and no structured retention process. Patients churned between visits, referrals were tracked manually, and staff had no central queue.
adentics.solution: We built Adentics in Angular: a cross-site patient portal where patients authenticate once and access their full treatment history across all clinic locations. Five patient modules cover the full journey — Treatment Timeline, Termine (appointment booking), Nachrichten (in-app messaging), Family & Referrals management, and an Academy for patient education. The admin side provides a Treatment Queue for staff. A premium teal-and-gold design system signals clinical trust. Deployed on Azure Static Web Apps.
adentics.subtitle: Premium multi-site patient portal for a German-speaking dental practice group

ai.problem: A document-heavy operations team was spending 30+ hours per week manually reading supplier invoices, extracting line-item data, and entering it into their ERP. Error rates hovered around 4%, causing reconciliation delays every month-end.
ai.solution: We built a Python + FastAPI pipeline that uses GPT-4 to extract structured data from unstructured PDFs, validates it against business rules, and pushes approved records directly into the ERP via REST. Edge cases are routed to a human review queue.
ai.subtitle: Intelligent document processing and workflow automation engine

work.ctaText: Like what you see? Let's build something together.

ecommerce.problem: The client's Magento store was hitting performance ceilings during sales events (4s+ load times, cart abandonment spiking to 72%), while the marketing team had zero ability to personalise listings without developer involvement.
ecommerce.solution: We rebuilt the front end as a headless React + GraphQL storefront backed by a custom .NET CMS. A lightweight recommendation engine surfaces personalised product suggestions based on browsing history. Editors now manage all content via the CMS.
ecommerce.subtitle: Headless e-commerce platform with a personalisation engine

fintech.problem: The client's analysts were exporting data from three separate tools into Excel, reconciling it manually, and generating PDF reports — a process that consumed 12+ hours per analyst per week and introduced errors at every step.
fintech.solution: We built a unified Angular + .NET analytics platform that ingests data in real time via WebSocket feeds, visualises it with interactive Chart.js dashboards, and generates one-click PDF reports. The architecture was designed for 50+ concurrent users and integrates with their existing Auth0 SSO.
fintech.subtitle: Real-time financial analytics platform for mid-market investment firms

jp.problem: JP Immobilien operates four distinct property divisions — New Build, Rental Properties, Hospitality, and Serviced Apartments — each with separate client touchpoints and manual process flows. Clients had no unified portal, account managers handled all requests via email, and there was no centralised visibility of contracts, documents, or project status across divisions.
jp.solution: We built a premium Angular + Angular Material client portal with division-scoped access. Clients authenticate once and navigate between their active New Build, Rental, Hospitality, and Serviced Apartment accounts from a single dashboard. Document management, status tracking, and in-portal messaging consolidate all communication in one place and eliminate email back-and-forth. A clean gold-and-navy design system reflects JP Immobilien's premium market positioning.
jp.subtitle: Premium multi-division client portal for an Austrian property group

karimpol.problem: Karimpol operates across five markets — Austria, Poland, Slovakia, Czech Republic, and Hungary — with no unified platform for project tracking or client communication. Development teams and clients navigated multiple systems and email threads to track project milestones, documents, and approval workflows, creating visibility gaps and delays across borders.
karimpol.solution: We built a multi-locale Angular + Angular Material portal spanning all five markets. Property development project pages surface real-time status, milestone tracking, and document repositories for each scheme. A role-based access model lets Karimpol staff manage projects per market while clients see only their relevant developments. Deployed globally on Azure Static Web Apps.
karimpol.subtitle: Corporate property development portal for a Central European real estate group

logistics.problem: The client was coordinating 80+ drivers via WhatsApp and a shared Google Sheet. Deliveries were missed, routes were duplicated, and there was no proof-of-delivery mechanism — creating disputes with enterprise clients.
logistics.solution: We built a Flutter app (iOS + Android) with a .NET backend. Dispatchers assign jobs in real time on a map interface; drivers receive push notifications, capture signatures on delivery, and GPS coordinates are logged automatically.
logistics.subtitle: Cross-platform mobile app for a growing logistics provider

neovize.problem: NeoVize Group operates four distinct ophthalmology product brands — NeoVize (premium laser correction), DuoVize (duet vision packages), NeoVizia (IOL replacement), and Kukátko (paediatric vision) — each with its own consent documents and pre-operative assessment flows. Without a unified platform, patient coordinators managed paper forms and email threads per product, creating delays, compliance risk, and a fragmented patient experience.
neovize.solution: We built a unified Angular patient portal that adapts per brand. Patients select their product portal on login and work through a structured digital pre-op assessment — biometric uploads, health questionnaire, and consent forms with e-signature capture. A custom blue & teal design system matches NeoVize Group's clinical identity across all four brands, while coordinators monitor pending assessments from a shared dashboard.
neovize.subtitle: Patient-facing multi-product ophthalmology portal for NeoVize Group

omida.problem: OMIDA Group S.A. operates 9 separate logistics entities — road, ocean, rail, warehousing, and more — each with its own systems and customer logins. Enterprise clients using multiple OMIDA services had no unified view of their shipments, documents, or invoices, creating fragmented communication and a weak competitive story against integrated rivals like Rohlig SUUS.
omida.solution: We built an Angular MVP shipper portal that unifies all 9 OMIDA entities under one login. The centrepiece is a cross-entity shipment timeline showing road, ocean, rail, and warehouse activity in a single dashboard — the story no competitor can tell. The portal includes a live multi-mode map (Leaflet, real OMIDA corridors), a document vault, and an entity-badge system that tags every record with its operating company.
omida.subtitle: Unified multi-entity shipper portal MVP for a €330M Polish logistics holding

vedos.problem: VEDOS, a logistics company operating Automotive JIT circuits and cold-chain routes across Slovakia and Germany, managed dispatching through manual phone calls and spreadsheets. Dispatchers had no live visibility of fleet positions, JIT circuit status, or temperature alerts — making it impossible to react to delays before they became SLA breaches.
vedos.solution: We built an Angular + Material Design 3 shipper portal backed by a .NET API. Dispatchers get a live fleet map (Leaflet, 30-second refresh), an Automotive JIT board with per-circuit SLA tracking (±15 min), cold-chain monitoring with real-time temperature alerts, and an integrated quoting workflow. The portal is role-scoped per customer and deployed globally on Azure Static Web Apps.
vedos.subtitle: Real-time logistics portal for a Slovak transport & freight company
